name: SparkDash
description: Monitor GPU, memory, network, and local model metrics across DGX Spark and other hosts in a web dashboard.
compatibility: SSH collectors for Linux, macOS, and Windows hosts; HTTP probes for local model servers.
limitations: The dashboard runs on Linux; monitored hosts may use other operating systems.
Remote monitoring needs SSH access; review authentication before exposing the dashboard.
